deploymentBoundary.reason: 当前 main 已部署: release 4 was built from 39a2d2d after its CI run passed, and the live site serves this build's asset hashes. Any commit after it is this checkpoint's own documentation update, which ships no artifact — if a later commit changes code, this record is stale until re-verified.

bundleBaseline.measuredAt: 2026-08-22, after waves 4-5 added 37 structures and the seed catalogue was deferred out of the entry chunk
bundleBaseline.entryBudgetRationale: The 900 KiB budget is unchanged and was not raised to fit new data. What changed is that the seed structure catalogue no longer sits in the entry at all. Waves 4 and 5 added 37 structures (49.3 KiB and 38.1 KiB of source), and the wave-5 build failed the guard at 917.0 KiB against 900 — correctly, because api/structureFallback was statically imported by two eager screens and chart/connectionField pulled a two-line slugOfOp helper out of the same module, anchoring the whole catalogue on the first-paint path. The code fix is a cherry-pick of 6a7f953 from the wave-3 branch, taken verbatim so the later merge stays clean; only these measurements are this branch's own, because that branch measures a 371-island atlas against a 1024 KiB budget and neither number describes this tree. Entry now measures 701.15 kB raw / 230.45 kB gzip, 176.87 kB below the 2026-08-04 baseline it replaces, and the catalogue loads as its own 238.37 kB chunk when a reader opens the structure lens. Note how the wave-4 commit got here: it reported typecheck and test green without running pnpm build, which is in neither gate. It happened to pass with roughly 21 KiB of headroom, but that was luck rather than verification, and it is the same gap 6a7f953 documents.

runtimeBudgetTargets.scope: Local browser diagnostics; not production RUM and not evidence that the current working tree is deployed.

l0AtlasReady.note: Not published on a cold shared link: that route mounts the island directly and never creates the atlas renderer, so the interval is abandoned rather than completed.

l1IslandReady.end: island scene committed plus two animation frames

proofBoundaries: The CI result proves only the recorded committed main baseline.
The production health and counts prove the older deployed release, not current main.
Local browser and build checks for later hardening work must be reported separately from CI and deployment.
